newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Stocks rises on better year results.
newsitem.headline: Stocks rises on better year results.

text.p: Shares in construction firm Stocks and Stocks rallied in early Friday trade after the company posted better-than-expected results on Thursday, dealers said.
The shares were last trading up 16 cents or 5.6 percent to 300 cents on turnover of 108,200 shares after earlier hitting a high of 310 cents.
"The shares are rising purely on the back of the fact that their results were better than expected," a trader said.
The company announced on Thursday that earnings for the year to April 30 rose to 69 cents a share from 49 cents previously.
Analysts polled by Reuters had forecast earnings to fall to between 57.0 and 63.0 cents a share with consensus at 61.0 cents.
